posts.preview: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations will begin stakeholder consultations on Thursday, 09 July 2026 at 11:00 with Government Ministries and Agencies, employers, and trade unions as part of its oversight mission on employment conditions in Namibia’s retail and w...

The mission seeks to assess compliance with labour laws and promote fair, safe, and dignified working conditions, focusing on issues such as wages, working hours, job security, workplace safety, employee benefits, gender equality, and worker welfare

Following the consultations, the Committee will conduct oversight visits from 13–18 July 2026 in the Oshana and Ohangwena regions. The mission will continue to Kavango East, Zambezi, and Erongo in August, with Khomas scheduled for September
